objections.about: The customer asked why the log says "follow gate skipped (confirmed follower)", and the reply never says that the gate is skipped because the test account is already confirmed as a follower, which is the direct answer.

The reply tells the customer to turn on Ask for a follow, reconnect the account, and rewrite the gate message, but the customer already has a working follow gate that passed last week on the same account, so these steps don't address their situation and may send them chasing a problem that isn't there.
